error.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. If it happens again, quote the reference below to support.
error.SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The verification service is not reachable. The fault is on our side, and the reference you entered is fine.
error.VERIFICATION_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: No certificate or service entitlement matches that reference.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many lookups. Wait a moment and try again.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: The service is having trouble. Try again in a few minutes.
error.FORBIDDEN: Your account does not hold the authority for this action.
error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
empty.verification.governed: The reference is valid, but no public record is approved for display.

mock.data: This page runs on sample data and is not connected to the live service yet. Every premises, person, amount and reference here is made up.
